about:
# Veilmap

A World Map addon for WoW Forever.

Fog data covers 84 map art IDs / 1073 overlays, generated from WoW build 1.60.1.69913.

- Reveals fog of war as a tinted overlay in a colour you choose, rather than removing it
- Scales the world map
- Sets map transparency, so the map stays usable while you move
- Shows player and cursor coordinates

## Development

Fog data is generated from [wago.tools](https://wago.tools/) DB2 exports:

    node tools/genfogdata.mjs --build 1.60.1.69913 --out Fog/Data_Forever.lua

Tests:

    cd tools && npm test

## Licence

GPL-3.0-or-later. See `LICENSE`.

## Veilmap 1.2.0

- Draw close-zoom detail on a plain frame so it works in combat
- Drop deep zoom: extending Blizzard's zoom levels taints the map in combat
- Amend phase 5 spec: drop deep zoom (taint), detail layer as a plain frame
- Guard the detail pin's release against a pool not yet created
- Fix one-liner A to print both coordinates
- Apply pin frame levels, drop stale detail after combat map changes
- Add phase 5 in-game checklist and prepare 1.2.0
- Zoom zone and city maps deeper than Blizzard's limit
- Fade the game's minimap terrain in under the fog as zone maps are zoomed
- Add pure tile placement, clipping, fade and zoom-step maths
- Generate the minimap tile table for close-zoom detail
- Add phase 5 implementation plan; settle the zoom slider range
- Add Veilmap phase 5 close-zoom detail design spec
